fields.Name: Collaboration Space Subtree
fields.Description: Returns all space IDs in the subtree reachable by the acting user, starting from PrimaryScopeRecordID.
fields.SQL:
WITH Subtree AS (
    SELECT s.ID AS SpaceID, 0 AS Steps
    FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[Space] s
    INNER JOIN [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[fnCollaborationAccess]('{{ UserID }}') a ON a.SpaceID = s.ID
    WHERE s.ID = TRY_CAST('{{ PrimaryScopeRecordID }}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT c.ID AS SpaceID, p.Steps + 1
    FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[Space] c
    INNER JOIN Subtree p ON c.ParentID = p.SpaceID
    INNER JOIN [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[fnCollaborationAccess]('{{ UserID }}') a ON a.SpaceID = c.ID
    WHERE c.InheritsMembership = 1 AND p.Steps < 32
)
SELECT CONVERT(NVARCHAR(36), SpaceID) AS SpaceID FROM Subtree
